 CAPITAL REGION, NY (WRGB) — Sunday marks the last day of early voting for the midterm elections.
 Here is a breakdown of the unofficial voting totals from the New York State Board of Elections.
 Day 8 Early Voting Oct 31: 
 Albany County:3,917 
 Early Voting Total: 37,396
 Columbia County: 826 
 Early Voting Total:7,888
 Fulton County: 339 
 Early Voting Total: 3,090
 Montgomery County: 408

 Rensselaer County: 1,618 
 Early Voting Total: 14,013
 Saratoga County: 3,030

 Schoharie County: 324

 Warren County: 729

 Washington County: 469 
 Early Voting Total:4,534
 The early voting total outside of NYC is 1,132,912. The statewide total for ealry voting is 1,705,698, according to the New York State Board of Elections.
